Welcome to The Ritz-Carlton, Masai Mara Safari Camp
Embrace the Wilderness on a Journey of a Lifetime
Elevated among lush trees in the heart of the Masai Mara National Reserve, The Ritz-Carlton, Masai Mara introduces its legendary service to a revered safari destination. Sustainably designed in harmony with nature, this elegant Masai Mara safari camp blends luxury, authenticity and adventure to craft once-in-a-lifetime moments. Architecturally unique and seamlessly integrated into the natural wilderness, the 20 suites at this Luxury Safari Camp in Masai Mara feature private decks, plunge pools, personalized butler service and stunning views. Awaken with a profound sense of nature’s awe as you witness the mesmerizing sights and sounds. Fuel your days’ adventures with expertly crafted dishes inspired by local and international flavors, complemented by an exclusive wine cellar. Indulge in wellness treatments integrating native traditions, explore the Map Room or discover the Photography Studio to capture the magic of your luxury safari in Kenya's Masai Mara and transform your memories into lasting treasures.
Concierge Service
Before arrival, enjoy a personal call with our General or Camp Manager to understand what matters most to you. From preferences to special moments, we tailor every detail - shaping a safari experience that feels deeply personal and entirely your own.
A Location That Enthralls From Sunrise to Sunset
Safari
Connect with the untamed beauty of the Sand River where wildlife gathers during the Great Migration. Enjoy unparalleled views of the Masai Mara’s and Serengeti’s savannahs and vibrant wildlife. Explore the Kenya-Tanzania Border Stone, a landmark linking Masai Mara and Serengeti ecosystems. Encounter the Big Five and other breathtaking wildlife on an expertly guided wildlife safari.

The Circuit Offer
Two Iconic Safari Destinations. One Extraordinary Journey
From the endless plains of the Masai Mara to the conservation rich landscapes surrounding Mount Kenya, this four night safari escape brings together two of Kenya’s most celebrated destinations. Enjoy luxurious accommodation, exceptional dining, immersive wildlife encounters, and conservation led experiences designed to create unforgettable moments. Reserve The Safari Circuit and enjoy 10% savings on your journey through Kenya.
Your Journey Includes:
2 Nights at The Ritz Carlton Masai Mara
Luxurious accommodation with personalized butler service
Daily game drives in a private open Safari Land Cruiser with expert guides and refreshments
Professional Canon cameras and guidance from resident safari photographers
Bush breakfast, picnic lunch, or sundowners, weather permitting
All inclusive meals with premium alcoholic and non alcoholic beverages
Binoculars for your stay
Maasai Village Visit and cultural immersion
60 minute spa treatment per person
2 Nights at JW Marriott Mount Kenya Rhino Reserve Safari Camp
Luxury accommodation with full board dining
Select alcoholic and non alcoholic beverages
Two shared game drives daily within Solio Game Reserve
Bush dining experiences and sundowners, weather permitting
Guided nature walks and bicycle safaris within Solio Game Reserve
Rhino Orphanage visit, veterinary programme
One photography session during the stay
One night game drive per stay
Terms and Conditions
Offer is applicable to standard villa categories only.
The stay must comprise exactly two nights at The Ritz Carlton Masai Mara and two nights at JW Marriott Mount Kenya Rhino Reserve Safari Camp.
Any change to the length of stay, including an early departure or alteration to the two night stay at either camp, may result in a rate adjustment.
Exclusions: The package excludes conservation and park entrance fees, premium wines and spirits, champagne, spa treatments, gratuities, and additional activities not specified in the inclusions.
All inclusions are subject to availability and weather conditions where applicable.
The offer is subject to hotel availability and may be withdrawn or amended without prior notice.
The Safari Circuit brings together the legendary wildlife of the Masai Mara and the remarkable conservation story of Solio Game Reserve for an exceptional Kenyan safari.
To Book, Please Contact Our Reservations Team At:
reservations@ritzcarltonsafaricamp.com
reservations@jwmarriottmountkenyasafaricamp.com

Retreat to Sanctuaries in Harmony With Nature
Luxury Tented Suites
Perched among lush treetops in the heart of the Masai Mara, The Ritz-Carlton, Masai Mara Safari Camp invites you to immerse yourself in a world where refined luxury meets the untamed beauty of Africa. Thoughtfully designed to blend seamlessly with its breathtaking surroundings, each elevated tent offers an unrivaled vantage point over the sweeping savannah, providing uninterrupted views of roaming wildlife. Expansive decks, private plunge pools, and personalized butler service create a sanctuary of indulgence, where every detail is curated for comfort and serenity. Here, modern sophistication intertwines effortlessly with the rhythms of nature, crafting an immersive safari experience unlike any other. Whether unwinding in your elegant Masai Mara safari accommodation or sharing stories beneath a canopy of starlit skies, you’ll find yourself embraced by the timeless magic of the wild.
At a Glance
Immerse into sustainably elegant surroundings that blur the lines between wilderness and comfort.
An elevated retreat ideal for families, 2-bedroom suites offer treetop views and gracious space
Your Encholiek - A personalised butler service ensures that your unique needs are attended to with exquisite care.
Presidential Suite
The Two-Bedroom Presidential Suite is the pinnacle of luxury at 617 sqm, perfect for families or groups. It features two bedrooms, each with a private bathroom, complemented by an expansive living and dining area, pantry, and kitchenette, as well as an outdoor dining deck, sunken lounge, and a large plunge pool with amazing views of Masai Mara and Serengeti. With a dedicated butler, all-inclusive gourmet dining, private game drives, and exclusive amenities, this suite ensures the ultimate safari experience in unparalleled comfort.
Two Bedroom Executive Suite
The Two-Bedroom Executive Suite offers an elevated retreat ideal for families or small groups. At 232 sqm, it features two elegantly designed bedrooms; a king and twin, a generous living area, a pantry, and an expansive outdoor dining deck with a plunge pool overlooking the Sand River. Enjoy personalized butler service - Your Encholiek - , all-inclusive dining, daily game drives, and exclusive amenities, ensuring a seamless blend of luxury, comfort, and adventure.
One Bedroom Suite
The One-Bedroom Suite offers an intimate retreat, blending refined luxury with breathtaking wilderness views. Spanning 163 sqm, it features a spectacular elevated plunge pool, offering uninterrupted views of the wild. Perfect for a refreshing dip or a moonlit soak under the stars, this private oasis is the ultimate indulgence. A dedicated butler - Your Encholiek, all-inclusive dining, daily game drives, and access to a professional camera and binoculars ensure an immersive and unforgettable safari experience.

A Memorable Escape
Your Encholiek – Our Butler Service
In Maasai tradition, an Encholiek is someone who walks alongside you, offering guidance, support, and companionship as needed. At our retreat, your dedicated butler embodies this role, ensuring every aspect of your stay is flawlessly orchestrated. From arranging private game drives to curating intimate in-suite dining under the stars, they anticipate your desires with impeccable attention to detail.
A Riverside Haven in Masai Mara
Each luxurious suite is strategically positioned along the Sand River, offering sweeping views of golden savannahs, winding riverbanks, and distant acacia-dotted horizons. From dawn to dusk, witness the ever-changing hues of the African sky, roaming wildlife, and the dramatic spectacle of the Great Migration. Whether sunrise or sundown, every glance unveils nature’s raw, untamed beauty.

Signature Safari Suites in Masai Mara
Signature Suites
Elevated among the treetops overlooking the Sand River, our Signature Safari Suites redefine safari living through exceptional space, privacy and personalized service. Designed as refined residential retreats in the heart of the Masai Mara, these exclusive tented suites seamlessly blend indoor and outdoor living with immersive wildlife experiences, dedicated Encholiek service and thoughtful luxury at every turn. Whether traveling as a family, celebrating a milestone occasion or seeking a more private safari escape, these Suites offer a rare sense of connection to nature, to loved ones and to the timeless rhythm of the Mara.
Presidential Suite
Positioned to embrace sweeping views of the Sand River and the surrounding wilderness stretching across the Masai Mara and Serengeti, the Presidential Suite offers the Camp’s most exclusive safari experience. This expansive 617 sqm two-bedroom residence features refined indoor and outdoor lounges, a private dining area, kitchenette, heated plunge pool and expansive viewing deck designed for elevated entertaining and private retreat living. From sunrise coffee overlooking the riverbanks to evenings beneath starlit skies, every detail is thoughtfully crafted for extraordinary moments in the wild.
Presidential Suite Room
Presidential Suite Room
Presidential Suite Room
Sunrise to Starlight at the Deck
Framed by sweeping views of the Sand River and the vast plains beyond, the Presidential Suite’s expansive outdoor deck invites moments of quiet indulgence surrounded by nature’s grandeur. Featuring a heated infinity plunge pool, elegant lounging spaces and open-air living areas, the deck is designed for sunrise coffees, private sundowners and evenings beneath the stars, embraced by the beauty of both Masai Mara and Serengeti.
A Private Lounge Experience
Thoughtfully designed for elevated gatherings and relaxed moments, the Presidential Suite’s living room blends refined residential comfort with sweeping views of the surrounding landscape. Featuring elegant lounge seating, a kitchenette, a private dining area and a dedicated bar, the space creates a seamless setting for entertaining, intimate dining and unwinding in complete privacy.
Two Bedroom Executive Suite
Designed for families and shared safari journeys, the 232 sqm Two-Bedroom Executive Suite offers a warm and elegant retreat immersed in the beauty of the Masai Mara. Featuring a king bedroom and a second bedroom with two queen beds, the suite includes spacious interconnected living areas, refined safari-inspired interiors, expansive outdoor decks and a heated plunge pool. Overlooking the Sand River and surrounding wilderness, it is thoughtfully designed for guests seeking comfort, privacy and meaningful moments together in the heart of the wild.
Two Bedroom Executive Suite
Where Every Journey is Shared
From sunrise game drives to evenings beneath the stars, the Two-Bedroom Executive Suite is designed to bring families and friends closer together. Spacious indoor and outdoor living areas create room to reconnect between adventures, while the privacy of two beautifully appointed bedrooms ensures every guest enjoys their own place to unwind. With your dedicated Encholiek curating every detail, each shared moment becomes part of an unforgettable Masai Mara story.

From tailored safari planning and dedicated Encholiek service to twice-daily game drives led by expert KPSGA guides, each journey is designed around meaningful discovery. Guests can savor curated culinary experiences in extraordinary settings, enjoy complimentary transfers to and from Keekorok and Serena Airstrips, and reconnect through restorative wellness rituals at Whispering Tree Spa inspired by nature, local traditions and the rhythms of the Mara.
